item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=algorithmic+criteria+for+identifying+epistemic+peers+and+evaluating+source+reliability+in+artificial+intelligence&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.7335558\", \"title\": [\"Epistemic Logic for Artificial Intelligence: Defining the Modal Logic of Algorithmic Knowledge\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>This paper proposes an axiomatization of algorithmic knowledge, an extension of epistemic modal logic for artificially intelligent systems that must compute their knowledge.&nbsp;</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7335558\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.6143609\", \"title\": [\"The Algorithmic Architectonics of Doubt: Artificial Intelligence and the Structural Engineering of Epistemic Uncertainty\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>This manuscript critically examines the role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the contemporary digital sphere, arguing that AI functions not as a definitive solution to the crisis of misinformation, but as an Algorithmic Architectonics of Doubt (AAD), structurally engineering and intensifying epistemic uncertainty. We propose that the AAD operates through three primary, interconnected mechanisms: Algorithmic Opacity, which transforms knowledge into an unverified \\\"algorithmic truth\\\" accepted on faith; Synthetic Realities, which erode the foundational reliability of sensory evidence through high-fidelity generative media; and Epistemic Fragmentation, which uses personalization algorithms to splinter shared reality into polarized, insular information universes. Drawing on interdisciplinary scholarship from social epistemology, AI ethics, and global studies, this paper synthesizes these mechanisms into a unified conceptual framework. We further explore the Paradox of Algorithmic Verification, where AI-driven fact-checking engages in an escalating \\\"algorithmic arms race\\\" with AI-driven deception.
